title: ID0414789-DC/SI-D/NL-[MP/P0 170001089]dispenser light goes blue and vise versa.
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The lights of the dispenser and the charging center are reversed. Due to this issue, when you charge on the center the dispenser
light goes blue and vise versa.
Solution : Configuration changed according to the groups.
